verdict.rationale: Rippling IT ships AI features (e.g., 'Ask Rippling AI anything across all your data'), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack has no documented opt-out, data-use policy, or commitment that customer data is excluded from AI model training. The AI-tool visibility in identity management covers employees' third-party AI apps, not Rippling's own data use, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
